description.value: Functional Pi Pizzeria is a Whistler pizza shop blending East Coast inspiration — classic New York-style slices and Detroit-style pan crust — made with house-prepared dough and premium imported ingredients. The menu offers a range of creative specialty pies alongside a fully customizable build-your-own option. Touring cyclists can stop in for a filling dine-in meal or grab a takeout order to fuel up on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms operation as a dine-in and takeout pizza restaurant in Whistler. Phone number 604-962-3141 is confirmed by both the website title/header and OSM. The website explicitly states 'Vegan, vegetarian and gluten-friendly options are available' and lists specific vegan menu items; takeout is confirmed by 'PICKUP ONLY' and 'dine-in or take-out' language. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: No street address present in OSM record or resolvable from website content — directory listing will lack a physical address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Whistler restaurant with confirmed takeout service, vegan/vegetarian/GF options, and a menu well-suited to hungry touring cyclists. No address is available from OSM or the website to display, which is a minor gap but not a disqualifier.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'PICKUP ONLY' in the header and 'dine-in or take-out' in the body copy

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Vegan, vegetarian and gluten-friendly options are available.' Specific vegan items include Vegan Mos Def (vegan cheese, Beyond Meat Italian Sausage) and a vegan option on the Greek Garden pizza
